name: range-slider
description: Dual-thumb numeric range slider with labeled native inputs and formatted values.
designIntent: Data dashboards need a low/high range for revenue, EBITDA or dates, but a single range input cannot express two thumbs accessibly. RangeSlider composes two native range inputs so keyboard and screen-reader behavior stay native while the track renders one selection.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial low/high pair when uncontrolled. Defaults to [min, max].

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the next low/high pair.

props.name: startLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the low thumb.

props.name: endLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the high thumb.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formats the displayed values and aria-valuetext.

props.name: showValues
props.description: Show the current low/high values above the track.

examples.title: Revenue range
examples.code:
<RangeSlider
  min={5}
  max={100}
  defaultValue={[5, 100]}
  startLabel="Revenue minimum"
  endLabel="Revenue maximum"
  formatValue={(value) => `$${value}M`}
  onValueChange={setRevenue}
/>

antiPatterns.title: Don't use a single range input for two values
antiPatterns.explanation: A single thumb cannot express a minimum and maximum. Use RangeSlider when both ends are adjustable.

antiPatterns.title: Don't hide the labels
antiPatterns.explanation: Each thumb needs a distinct accessible name so screen-reader users know which end they are changing.

accessibility.implementation: Two input[type=range] elements with individual aria-label and aria-valuetext
accessibility.userRequirements: Give each thumb a distinct label and format values with the same unit shown on screen

accessibility.implementation: The low thumb cannot move above the high thumb and vice versa
accessibility.userRequirements: Pass a valid min/max range and a step that reflects the real granularity

guidelines: Use the same unit on both ends
Prefer 5/50/100 style milestones when exact values are not meaningful

compositionRules.relationship: Place RangeSlider inside a filter panel or FilterBar for live numeric filtering
